main_measure.name: mean strength of long cases over 5 bars (unusual move / usual 5-bar move)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases grouped by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move above-median forecast minus at/below-median

decided_by: The t of the mean strength is between -2 and 2.
reading: A case is the first long bet (forecast rise of at least 2 points from its lowest long level since the last bet) in each 5-bar grid cell of a window, the day t uses the day-summed deviations with a D/(D-1) correction, the supporting check uses the unusual move (not divided by the usual move), and fewer than 30 cases or 30 days is reported as not observable.
